focus: Current Vega-Lite mark/encoding, auto-guides, sizing, legends, formatting, and transforms
noveltyJustification: Current official pages confirm the declarative/runtime behaviors and expose a numeric default-width inconsistency; the pinned corpus supplies static contract-compatible equivalents without a runtime dependency.
keyQuestions: What does current Vega-Lite generate automatically?
Which sizing, legend, formatting, and transform defaults matter to the corpus comparison?
answeredQuestions: A mark plus encoding automatically yields axes, legends, and scales unless customized.
width:container uses an externally sized container and window resize; autosize defaults to pad and supports fit variants.
Legends default to right, use gradients for non-binned quantitative/temporal color, and use parity/greedy overlap strategies.
format covers text, tooltips, axes, legends, and headers; transforms are ordered arrays with field transforms.
The corpus provides static explicit SVG equivalents and intentionally avoids runtime Vega-Lite behavior.
ruledOutDirections: Adding Vega-Lite as a runtime dependency.
Using an unqualified numeric default width from the inconsistent current prose.
